slides.title: STOP SKIPPING THE 20-MINUTE WALK
slides.sub: It levels up 3 stats at once →

slides.text: Stiff body. Foggy head. Restless nights.
slides.sub: And you call it being busy.

slides.text: Your legs, heart and lungs get daily work.
Leave the phone in your pocket. Think.
slides.sub: Your best ideas show up outside.

slides.text: Pray while you walk. Out loud if you can.
“…they shall walk, and not faint.”
slides.sub: Start with one lap of the block.

slides.title:
SHOES ON.
START TODAY.
slides.text: The System turns your daily walk into a quest with a streak. Coming soon.

posts.hook:
YOUR FAITH STAT
POWERS ALL THE OTHERS.
STOP SKIPPING IT.

slides.title: YOU SAID “I'LL PRAY FOR YOU.” DID YOU?
slides.sub: Fix it with a prayer list →

slides.text: You meant it. Then you forgot by dinner.
Name, need, date. One line each.
Family Monday. Friends Tuesday. Church Wednesday.
slides.sub: A few names a day, not fifty.

slides.text: When God answers, write the date next to it.
“…by prayer and supplication… let your requests be made known unto God.”
slides.sub: Then go back and thank Him.

slides.title:
PRAY FOR THEM.
TODAY. NOT SOMEDAY.
slides.text: The System makes prayer a daily quest you can track. Coming soon.

scenes.cap: THEN YOU FEEL LIKE A FAILURE BY 7.

slides.title: HOW YOU TREAT PEOPLE IS A STAT

slides.text: Short with family. Kind to strangers online.
slides.sub: The people closest get the worst of you.

slides.title:
DAYS LEFT
IN 2026
slides.sub: 44 days to be easier to live with.

slides.text: Put the phone down when someone talks to you.
Thank one person by name today.
slides.sub: Be specific about what they did.

slides.text: “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another…”
slides.sub: Start with whoever annoys you most.

slides.title:
BE KIND ON PURPOSE.
START TODAY.
slides.text: The System tracks your Heart stat with daily people quests. Coming soon.

scenes.cap: YOU THINK IT'S TOO LATE TO CHANGE.

slides.text: Six more weeks of the same habits.
slides.sub: January won't do it for you.

slides.text: One chapter every morning before your phone.
Train 3 days a week. Walk the rest.
10 pages a night instead of scrolling.
Holiday budget set before Black Friday.
Call one family member every week.
slides.sub: Show up before the holidays do.

slides.title:
YOUR WINTER ARC STARTS
TONIGHT. NOT MONDAY.
